{{Quote|I've received intelligence that Roan Fel has planned a secret meeting with the Jedi on the planet Agamar. We're crashing their party.|Morlish Veed|<ref name="Legacy43" />}}
'''Operation: Thunderstroke''' was the code name for a mission sanctioned by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] [[Morlish Veed]] that involved ambushing a secret [[Mission to Agamar|meeting]] scheduled between [[Empire-in-exile|exiled]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Led by [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Rulf Yage]] and [[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro]] aboard the ''[[War Hammer]]'', the Imperials' primary objective was to capture Fel, so that he might stand trial and be sentenced to execution, effectively ending the resistance movement of his [[Empire-in-exile|exiled forces]].

The operation was planned to be carried out by the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]], a unit of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] formed by members of the [[One Sith]], who would lead [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]] from their [[Fury-class starfighter|''Fury''-class starfighters]]. The strikeforce failed to complete its prime objective, as Emperor Fel eluded capture. However, the Sith were successful in capturing [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Capture Fel alive if at all possible. A public trial and an even more public execution will end the Bastion resistance.|Morlish Veed|<ref name="Legacy43" />}}
When the rumors of [[Darth Krayt]]'s death reached to the remnants of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]], the surviving Jedi decided to join the fight alongside the newly formed coalition between [[Empire-in-exile|Fel's resistance]] and the surviving [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|Galactic Alliance]] forces led by [[Gar Stazi]]. [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], an agricultural world on the edge of the Fel-controlled space, was selected to be the location of the meeting.

Through the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], intel of this rendezvous reached Imperial [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] Veed, who planned an attack in order to capture Roan Fel and [[Marasiah Fel|his daughter]] so the deposed monarch would undergo public trial an execution. Veed hoped that by eliminating Fel, his [[Empire-in-exile]] would inevitably crumble.<ref name="Legacy43" /> Veed named the operation "Operation: Thunderstroke" and ordered Moffs Yage and Fehlaaur to oversee it and command the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]], a Navy unit composed by pilots of the [[One Sith]]. Yage himself, however, resented having to lead what he considered "monsters".<ref name="Legacy44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>

Under the protection of his [[Imperial Knight]]s, Fel [[Mission to Agamar|landed]] on Agamar to await the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] delegation, which was composed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[K'Kruhk]], also a member of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]], [[Rasi Tuum]] and [[Hira]], as well as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]]. Both parties dressed in the manner of Agamar's farmers to prevent recognition, though the Imperials were already en route. The Jedi agreed to cooperate with Emperor Fel and Admiral [[Gar Stazi]] and coordinate their attack with them. In retribution, both Bastion and Stazi's [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|forces]] would give safe haven to the Jedi.<ref name="Legacy45" />

Moff [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] arrived to Agamar to warn the allies, landing her starfighter at a distant farm so as not to alarm either party. Paying a [[Unidentified Agamarian farmer|native farmer]] to hide her vessel, Calixte proceeded to the meeting aboard a borrowed Agamarian beast, disguised in the farmer's cloak and hat.<ref name="Legacy45" />

The Imperial Knights sensed Calixte approaching and opened fire against her, having considered her a threat. Emperor Fel recognized her and ordered the shooting to stop. Surrounded by [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], Calixte warned both parties that the Sith knew of the meeting and would be arriving at any moment to hunt down Emperor Fel.<ref name="Legacy45" />

At that precise moment, the Sith forces, led by Yage's [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[War Hammer]]'', emerged from hyperspace and engaged Fel's own [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']].<ref name="Legacy45" />

==The operation==
{{Quote|The Emperor must survive at all costs, Master Draco.|Master Treis Sinde|<ref name="Legacy46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>}}
[[File:TreisSindeIsBadass-L46.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jedi and Imperial Knights battle Sith on the planet's surface.]]
The ''War Hammer'' deployed its squadrons of [[Sith-Imperial starfighter]]s and Sith Furies to attack the ''Dauntless'' as well as the delegations on the planet's surface. Aboard the ''Dauntless'', [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tohri Challon]] ordered her crew and pilots to attack the Sith Imperial forces in order to buy time for Emperor Fel to escape.<ref name="Legacy45" />

As the space battle progressed, several of the Fel loyalist pilots ejected from their damaged [[Predator-class fighter|Predator starfighters]] to save their lives. However, [[Darth Rauder]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] in command of the strikeforce pilots, ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gunn Yage]] to eliminate them as well. When Yage refused to follow Lady Rauder's orders, the Sith threatened to kill her with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] if she did not comply. Rauder employed her [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] abilities to exert pressure within Yage's head, causing her to bleed from nose and eyes.<ref name="Legacy45" /> However, to save Yage's life, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tev Rimon]] fired at the pilot, much to the anger of Lady Rauder, who wanted Yage to personally shoot at the enemy pilots and threatened to kill Rimon if he defied her orders again.<ref name="Legacy46" />

As Emperor Fel prepared to escape, the delegations were attacked by a group of several [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], amongst them a [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], and a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]. The Jedi and the Imperial Knights fought side by side to protect Emperor Fel so he could reach his shuttle, the ''[[Defender One]]'', killing some of the attacking Sith in the process. However, Master Hira perished when a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Unidentified Nautolan Sith (Agamar)|Sith]] struck her with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="Legacy46" />
[[File:Dauntless_destroyed.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Dauntless'' is destroyed by the ''War Hammer''.]]

Fel reached his shuttle alongside Masters [[Antares Draco]] and [[Treis Sinde]] while Princess [[Marasiah Fel]], Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]] and Master Rasi Tuum held off the enemy. Before the three could enter the shuttle, however, a number of enemy fighters approached. Though Master Draco desired to rescue the Princess, Master Sinde reminded him that the Emperor's safety was his priority and that they had to get off the planet. As Fel, Rae and Rasi Tuum were overwhelmed by the enemy fire, Draco ordered the shuttle's pilot to evacuate.<ref name="Legacy46" />

In space, the ''War Hammer'' had inflicted heavy damage to the ''Dauntless'', whose shields had already failed. However, Admiral [[Tohri Challon]] ordered her crew to keep on fighting until the Emperor's shuttle had made the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The shuttle successfully escaped but the ''Dauntless'' was destroyed. Admiral Challon, her second in command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Basile]], and the entire crew of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] perished.<ref name="Legacy46" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|My faithful soldiers. You died well. Draco, Princess Marasiah&hellip; is not dead. I still sense her in the Force, but&hellip; she's in the hands of the Sith.|Emperor Roan Fel|<ref name="Legacy46" />}}
[[File:Draco_fel.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Antares Draco promises his Emperor to save Princess Marasiah]]

Though the main objective of the operation was not achieved, the battle was not a defeat for the Sith Empire. The ''War Hammer'' managed to destroy the ''Dauntless'', depriving Fel's fleet of a valuable starship as well as a loyal Admiral, while the Sith sent to the planet succeeded in achieving the mission's second objective: the capture of Princess Marasiah Fel. Alongside Princess Sia, Azlyn Rae and her former Master, Rasi Tuum, were captured as well.<ref name="Legacy46" />

Emperor Fel managed to escape to hyperspace alongside Antares Draco and Treis Sinde, thanks to the efforts of his Knights and particularly the deaths of Admiral Challon and her crew. Once safe in hyperspace, Fel saluted the noble sacrifice of his soldiers, which he had witnessed as the ''Defender One'' flew above the ''War Hammer''. The Force also allowed Fel to sense that his daughter had survived the attack and that she was in custody of the Sith. He ordered Master Draco to save her, a task Draco swore to complete.<ref name="Legacy46" />

It was later revealed that the one who betrayed Fel to the Sith was [[Hogrum Chalk]], the Emperor's brother-in-law and the Imperial Knights' [[master armorer]].
